questions.question: Which GPT-6.2 model does OpenAI position as more capable?
questions.explanation: OpenAI puts Astra above Sol. Its first three names followed the masses of the Sun, Earth, and Moon. Astra means stars, which can be heavier or lighter than the Sun.
questions.scope: GPT-6.2 models, OpenAI positioning in November 2026
questions.caveat: This is OpenAI’s intended role/capability positioning, not a claim that Astra always wins on speed or cost.

questions.question: Which Gemini 4 model does Google rank higher?
questions.explanation: Google puts Carbon above Neon. A periodic table would lead you to pick Neon by both mass and atomic number.
questions.scope: Gemini 4 model choices in Gemini Apps, as documented November 2026
questions.caveat: The model positioning is vendor-defined. Atomic-mass comparison is an analogy, not Google’s declared naming rule.

questions.question: Which Claude model does Anthropic recommend for the hardest reasoning tasks?
questions.explanation: Anthropic recommends Fable when Opus at high effort falls short, placing a short moral story a tier above a magnum opus.
questions.scope: Anthropic November 2026 lineup; Fable is version 5.2 while other listed families are 5.5
questions.caveat: Different version numbers and task specializations matter; this is Anthropic’s recommendation for demanding reasoning, not an all-benchmark ranking.

questions.question: Which chip sits higher in Apple’s M2 lineup?
questions.explanation: M2 Ultra joins two M2 Max dies into one package, placing Ultra one tier above Max.
questions.scope: M2 generation only, not an assertion about newer-generation chips
questions.caveat: Relative power/energy efficiency varies by workload and device. Do not compare chip generations as part of this ladder.

questions.question: Which desktop RTX 4070 does NVIDIA rank higher?
questions.explanation: The 4070 Ti sits above the 4070 SUPER. NVIDIA also made a 4070 Ti SUPER, which sits above both.
questions.scope: Ada Lovelace GeForce RTX 4070 desktop cards, not laptop GPUs
questions.caveat: Individual benchmarks, factory overclocks, prices, and VRAM-sensitive games can vary; use NVIDIA’s within-family positioning.

questions.question: Which EC2 T2 instance comes with more memory?
questions.explanation: A t2.2xlarge has 32 GiB of memory, double the 16 GiB in a t2.xlarge.
questions.scope: AWS EC2 T2 instance family
questions.caveat: The order is for allocated vCPU/memory within one AWS instance family; not price/performance across generations or instance families.

questions.question: Which Quest has the higher-tier display and optics?
questions.explanation: Quest 3 has pancake lenses and a higher-resolution display. Quest 3S shares its processor but uses lower-tier optics.
questions.scope: Quest 3 generation, Meta’s compared 2026 US products
questions.caveat: The two models share a processor; Quest 3S has longer stated battery runtime. Rank specifically by display/optics, not total performance.

questions.question: Which Canon DSLR sits higher in the company’s professional lineup?
questions.explanation: Canon positions the EOS-1 series as its flagship professional DSLR line. In this numbering scheme, lower series numbers sit higher in the range.
questions.scope: Canon EOS DSLR era; camera models released in different years
questions.caveat: Not a claim of higher megapixels or superior image quality in every use; the 1D line is the rugged professional flagship.

questions.question: Which Xbox Series console has the more powerful graphics hardware?
questions.explanation: Series X is Microsoft’s higher-performance console. Series S is the smaller, lower-cost option.
questions.scope: Xbox Series console family
questions.caveat: The Series S is smaller and more affordable; this compares GPU/rendering capability, not the worth of owning either console.

questions.question: Which is Chase’s higher-tier Sapphire travel card?
questions.explanation: Sapphire Reserve sits above Sapphire Preferred in Chase’s travel-card lineup, carrying a higher annual fee and broader travel benefits.
questions.scope: US consumer Sapphire cards, November 2026
questions.caveat: This is Chase’s positioning/annual-fee and travel benefit tier, not a claim Reserve produces greater value for every customer.

questions.question: Which card sits higher in Capital One’s Venture lineup?
questions.explanation: Venture X sits above Venture. A single letter marks the jump to the premium travel card.
questions.scope: US consumer Capital One Venture lineup
questions.caveat: Ranks issuer product segment and annual-fee/benefit scope, not universal expected rewards for every spending pattern.

questions.question: Which U.S. personal card does Amex reserve for invited applicants?
questions.explanation: Centurion is the invitation-only card above Platinum. Its nickname is the Black Card.
questions.scope: US personal Green, Gold, Platinum; invitation-based Centurion at the top
questions.caveat: Gold/Platinum are not universally best for all spending categories. Centurion is invitation-only; details and annual fees vary by market.

questions.question: Which is Mastercard’s higher network tier?
questions.explanation: World Legend is Mastercard’s top network tier, introduced one level above World Elite.
questions.scope: Mastercard global premium CREDIT product portfolio, 2026
questions.caveat: Network tiers are separate from an issuing bank’s rewards program and card annual fee. Availability varies by market.

questions.question: Which is the higher U.S. Visa network tier?
questions.explanation: Visa puts Infinite above Signature. These are Visa network tiers shared by cards from different banks.
questions.scope: US Visa network brand tiers; issuer implementation varies
questions.caveat: Individual card benefits are set by issuers and are not guaranteed identical at each Visa network level. Not a bank-by-bank comparison.

questions.question: Which is the higher Marriott Bonvoy status?
questions.explanation: Marriott puts Titanium Elite one tier above Platinum Elite.
questions.scope: Marriott Bonvoy, November 2026
questions.caveat: Status eligibility involves nights and, for Ambassador, qualifying spend; actual benefits vary by property.

questions.question: Which is the higher Marriott Bonvoy status?
questions.explanation: Ambassador Elite sits above Titanium Elite, switching from metals to a title at the top of the program.
questions.scope: Marriott Bonvoy, November 2026
questions.caveat: Status eligibility involves nights and, for Ambassador, qualifying spend; actual benefits vary by property.

questions.question: Which is the higher World of Hyatt status?
questions.explanation: Globalist is the highest standard World of Hyatt status. Explorist is one tier below.
questions.scope: World of Hyatt member tiers, 2026
questions.caveat: Hyatt’s terms define status tiers; the words do not represent an objective hierarchy of people.

questions.question: Which is the higher Hilton Honors status?
questions.explanation: Diamond Reserve adds benefits above Diamond, including guaranteed late checkout.
questions.scope: Hilton Honors as of November 2026
questions.caveat: Hilton’s criteria/benefits are program-specific; Reserve is not a synonym for the unrelated Chase card.

questions.question: Which seating option is higher in United’s lineup?
questions.explanation: Premium Plus is premium economy. Economy Plus is an economy seat with extra legroom.
questions.scope: Routes/aircraft offering all four seat products; Polaris business-class long-haul service
questions.caveat: Economy Plus is extra-legroom economy seating; Premium Plus is premium economy; Polaris is business-class on eligible routes. Not all flights offer all classes.

questions.question: Which engineering title is more senior at GitLab?
questions.explanation: At GitLab, Staff Engineer is the level above Senior Engineer. Other employers set their own titles.
questions.scope: GitLab Development Department career framework; titles generalized to Engineer
questions.caveat: Job ladders vary by employer; this is specifically GitLab, not a universal global salary/status standard. Use Principal, not Principle.

questions.question: Which is the higher U.S. Army rank?
questions.explanation: A lieutenant general wears three stars. A major general wears two. Compare plain lieutenant and major and the order reverses.
questions.scope: United States Army commissioned officer structure
questions.caveat: Do not compare bare “Lieutenant” to “Major” and extrapolate to general-officer ranks. These are formal ranks, not titles of all militaries.

questions.question: Which is Ralph Lauren’s higher-end menswear label?
questions.explanation: Purple Label is Ralph Lauren’s luxury menswear line. Polo is the more accessible label.
questions.scope: Ralph Lauren menswear labels, not women’s Collection or RRL workwear
questions.caveat: Not a claim that every Purple Label item is more expensive or better than every Polo item. RRL is a parallel aesthetic, not an intermediate rung.

questions.question: Which menswear line does Armani position as more luxurious?
questions.explanation: Giorgio Armani is the house’s luxury main line. Emporio Armani sits below it.
questions.scope: Fashion labels in Armani’s brand architecture
questions.caveat: Positioning and average prices, not guaranteed garment-by-garment quality. Product categories and collaborations can differ.

questions.question: Which is the higher-performance member of Audi’s A3 family?
questions.explanation: The RS 3 sits above the S3 at the performance end of Audi’s A3 family.
questions.scope: A3-family US cars, comparable 2026 production generation
questions.caveat: This compares performance versions, not fuel economy, ride comfort, or price/insurance value.

questions.question: Which U.S. Audi trim includes more equipment when both are offered?
questions.explanation: Prestige is Audi’s top trim level, sitting above both Premium and Premium Plus.
questions.scope: Audi US trim nomenclature for cars offered with all three trims
questions.caveat: These trims and content depend on model year/vehicle; verify availability before applying to a specific car.

questions.question: Which of these trims sits higher in Lucid’s Air lineup?
questions.explanation: Air Sapphire is the ultra-high-performance flagship above Grand Touring. The latter can still be the better choice for range.
questions.scope: Lucid Air sedan trim lineup, as presented in 2026
questions.caveat: Do not say Sapphire has the best range: Grand Touring may prioritize range. The ladder is price/performance positioning.

questions.question: Which U.S. Starbucks size holds more iced coffee?
questions.explanation: Grande holds 16 fluid ounces. Tall is the smaller cup at 12.
questions.scope: US Starbucks iced coffee sizes (Tall 12, Grande 16, Venti 24, Trenta 30 fl oz)
questions.metric: fluid ounces per iced coffee serving
questions.caveat: Specific to the cited iced coffee product; hot venti is a different volume and Trenta is not offered for every beverage.

questions.question: Which U.S. Starbucks size holds more iced coffee?
questions.explanation: Trenta holds 30 fluid ounces. Venti means twenty in Italian, but an iced Venti holds 24.
questions.scope: US Starbucks iced coffee sizes (Tall 12, Grande 16, Venti 24, Trenta 30 fl oz)
questions.metric: fluid ounces per iced coffee serving
questions.caveat: Specific to the cited iced coffee product; hot venti is a different volume and Trenta is not offered for every beverage.

questions.question: Which GIA diamond grade has higher clarity?
questions.explanation: VS1 is a higher clarity grade than VS2. Within VS, the smaller number wins.
questions.scope: GIA 4Cs diamond clarity scale
questions.caveat: Clarity only—not the overall beauty, rarity, value, color, or cut of a diamond.

questions.question: Which GIA diamond grade has higher clarity?
questions.explanation: An Internally Flawless diamond can have surface blemishes. Flawless is the higher grade.
questions.scope: GIA 4Cs diamond clarity scale
questions.caveat: Clarity only—not the overall beauty, rarity, value, color, or cut of a diamond.

questions.question: Which GIA grade denotes a more colorless diamond?
questions.explanation: D is the most colorless grade on GIA’s D–Z scale. E comes next.
questions.scope: GIA D–Z diamond color scale (normal colorless-to-light-colored grading)
questions.caveat: This ranks absence of visible color for diamonds assessed on the D–Z scale, not beauty or market price for fancy-colored stones.

questions.question: Which is the higher Burgundy wine appellation?
questions.explanation: Grand Cru sits above Premier Cru in Burgundy’s appellation hierarchy, even though “premier” translates to “first.”
questions.scope: Traditional Bourgogne wine appellation designations
questions.caveat: Ranks legal appellation classification, not a blind-tasting guarantee or a universal claim about every individual bottle.

questions.question: Which of these two models ranked higher in OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 preview lineup?
questions.explanation: Terra ranked above Luna. Earth is more massive than the Moon, and mass gives you the order of all three original names.
questions.scope: GPT-5.6 preview lineup as announced by OpenAI
questions.caveat: These are the GPT-5.6 preview roles. Sol has a different role in the GPT-6.2 lineup.

questions.question: Which of these two models ranked higher in OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 preview lineup?
questions.explanation: Sol was the flagship and Terra was the everyday model. The original order followed their namesakes by mass, from Sun to Earth to Moon.
questions.scope: GPT-5.6 preview lineup as announced by OpenAI
questions.caveat: These are the GPT-5.6 preview roles. Sol has a different role in the GPT-6.2 lineup.

questions.question: Which did Google describe as the faster Gemini 2.5 model?
questions.explanation: Google introduced Flash-Lite as the fastest Gemini 2.5 model. The Lite suffix signaled lower cost and faster responses.
questions.scope: Google’s June 2025 announcement for the Gemini 2.5 family
questions.caveat: Google’s stated speed positioning. Actual latency varies with prompt, settings, and deployment.

questions.question: Which first-generation Nova model sits above the other in Amazon’s lineup?
questions.explanation: Amazon put Premier at the top for complex multimodal tasks. Pro was the general-purpose model balancing accuracy, speed, and cost.
questions.scope: First-generation Amazon Nova understanding models in AWS documentation
questions.caveat: Product roles within Nova version 1. These names do not rank newer Nova models or every benchmark.

questions.question: Which first-generation Nova model handles more kinds of input?
questions.explanation: Lite can take images and video as well as text. Micro is text-only, with a focus on low latency.
questions.scope: First-generation Amazon Nova understanding models in AWS documentation
questions.caveat: Product roles within Nova version 1. These names do not rank newer Nova models or every benchmark.

questions.question: Which Llama 4 model has more total parameters?
questions.explanation: Maverick has about 400 billion total parameters to Scout’s 109 billion. Both activate about 17 billion per token.
questions.scope: Total parameters of Meta’s released Llama 4 Scout and Maverick models
questions.caveat: Total parameters count the entire model, including experts that are not active for a given token.

questions.question: Which ElevenLabs v2.5 speech model is built for lower latency?
questions.explanation: Flash v2.5 is the lower-latency speech model. ElevenLabs describes it as faster than its earlier Turbo line.
questions.scope: ElevenLabs text-to-speech Turbo v2.5 and Flash v2.5 models
questions.caveat: Compares model latency. Network delays and audio quality are separate considerations.

questions.question: Which HDMI cable designation supports more bandwidth?
questions.explanation: Ultra96 is rated for up to 96 Gbps. Ultra High Speed stops at 48 Gbps. The number in Ultra96 is the bandwidth.
questions.scope: Official HDMI cable designations and their published bandwidth limits
questions.caveat: Cable certification indicates supported bandwidth. Actual throughput depends on the full setup.

questions.question: Which HDMI cable designation is rated for more bandwidth?
questions.explanation: Premium High Speed is certified for up to 18 Gbps. Ultra High Speed supports up to 48 Gbps.
questions.scope: Official HDMI cable designations and their published bandwidth limits
questions.caveat: Cable certification indicates supported bandwidth. Actual throughput depends on the full setup.

questions.question: Which SD standard allows the larger card capacity?
questions.explanation: SDXC stands for Extended Capacity and goes up to 2 TB. SDHC is High Capacity and tops out at 32 GB.
questions.scope: SD Association capacity designations, using each standard’s published maximum
questions.metric: maximum capacity allowed by the standard
questions.caveat: A capacity designation is unrelated to the card’s write speed and says nothing about its actual size within the range.

questions.question: Which SD card designation has the higher capacity ceiling?
questions.explanation: SDUC is Ultra Capacity, up to 128 TB. SDXC is Extended Capacity, up to 2 TB. Those are limits of the standards.
questions.scope: SD Association capacity designations, using each standard’s published maximum
questions.metric: maximum capacity allowed by the standard
questions.caveat: A capacity designation is unrelated to the card’s write speed and says nothing about its actual size within the range.

questions.question: Which SD card speed label specifies faster sustained writes?
questions.explanation: U3 specifies 30 MB/s of minimum sustained writes. V10 specifies 10 MB/s. The number in U3 uses a different scale.
questions.scope: SD Association UHS and Video Speed Class logos under their specified conditions
questions.caveat: Compare only the minimum write speeds represented by the logos. Other requirements and host compatibility differ.

questions.question: Which USB 3.2 label specifies a higher signaling rate?
questions.explanation: Gen 2×2 uses two 10 Gbps lanes for 20 Gbps. The original Gen 2 label describes the 10 Gbps mode.
questions.scope: Historical USB 3.2 specification labels, as documented by USB-IF
questions.caveat: These are different signaling modes. The Gen 1 mode has also had other names for the same speed.

questions.question: Which is the higher English football division?
questions.explanation: Clubs can go up from League One to the Championship. The Championship sits one level below the Premier League.
questions.scope: The three divisions operated by the English Football League
questions.metric: level in the English Football League
questions.caveat: Divisions in the league pyramid, rather than cup competitions or the standings in any season.

questions.question: Which is the higher Minor League Baseball level?
questions.explanation: Double-A sits above High-A. High-A is the higher of the two single-A levels.
questions.scope: The four modern full-season affiliated Minor League Baseball classifications
questions.caveat: The levels classify leagues. A player’s assignment does not measure talent independently of roster needs.

questions.question: Which of these is the higher FIDE chess title?
questions.explanation: International Master sits above FIDE Master. The standard title route for IM requires a higher rating and tournament norms.
questions.scope: FIDE open player titles for standard over-the-board chess
questions.caveat: Compares titles rather than current ratings. FIDE also awards a separate set of women’s titles.

questions.question: Which Champagne label allows more sugar per liter?
questions.explanation: Extra Dry is 12–17 g/L of sugar. Brut is below 12 g/L. Extra Dry is the sweeter category despite the name.
questions.scope: Comité Champagne’s sugar categories in grams per liter
questions.metric: upper end of the declared sugar range
questions.caveat: The ranges are labeling thresholds. They do not guarantee how sweet a particular bottle will taste.

questions.question: Which Champagne designation has the higher sugar limit?
questions.explanation: Sec runs from 17 to 32 g/L. Extra Dry tops out at 17 g/L. The French word sec translates to dry.
questions.scope: Comité Champagne’s sugar categories in grams per liter
questions.metric: upper end of the declared sugar range
questions.caveat: The ranges are labeling thresholds. They do not guarantee how sweet a particular bottle will taste.

questions.question: Which Grade A maple syrup designation passes less light?
questions.explanation: Amber Rich is darker than Golden Delicate. Less light passes through syrup in the amber category.
questions.scope: U.S. Grade A maple syrup color and flavor designations
questions.metric: depth of color in the USDA classification
questions.caveat: Color grouping is based on light transmission. It does not measure whether a taster will prefer the syrup.

questions.question: Which is the higher USDA beef quality grade?
questions.explanation: Choice is above Select in the USDA grades. Choice generally has more marbling than Select.
questions.scope: USDA’s common retail beef quality grades
questions.caveat: The grading system considers maturity and marbling. This comparison is about the labels rather than personal taste.

questions.question: Which U.S. egg size has the higher minimum weight per dozen?
questions.explanation: A dozen Jumbo eggs must weigh at least 30 ounces. Extra Large starts at 27 ounces.
questions.scope: U.S. shell egg size classes by minimum net weight per dozen
questions.metric: minimum weight for a dozen eggs
questions.caveat: Compares weight of a dozen shell eggs. The size class is separate from quality grades such as AA or A.

questions.question: Which label is higher on the North American avalanche danger scale?
questions.explanation: Considerable is level 3. Moderate is level 2 on the North American scale.
questions.scope: North American Public Avalanche Danger Scale
questions.caveat: These are the published names. Actual avalanche forecasts also depend on location, elevation, and time.

questions.question: Which Yosemite Decimal System grade is harder to climb?
questions.explanation: 5.10a is harder than 5.9. The part after the point is an ordinal grade, rather than a decimal fraction.
questions.scope: Technical grades for roped rock climbs on the Yosemite Decimal System
questions.caveat: Climbing grades are local judgments of technical difficulty and do not describe overall risk.

questions.question: At the outer edge of which kind of twilight is the Sun farther below the horizon?
questions.explanation: The outer limit of nautical twilight is 12° below the horizon. For civil twilight it is 6°.
questions.scope: U.S. Naval Observatory definitions at the outer boundary of twilight
questions.metric: angular depth of the Sun below the horizon at the boundary
questions.caveat: These are geometric definitions. Actual visibility depends on local weather, terrain, and lighting.

questions.question: Which is the higher British Airways cabin on long-haul flights?
questions.explanation: Club World is business class. World Traveller Plus is premium economy.
questions.scope: British Airways cabin names on routes with the compared long-haul classes
questions.caveat: This compares cabin class, not seat hardware on particular aircraft or the price on any given itinerary.

questions.question: Which Atmos Rewards tier requires more status points?
questions.explanation: Atmos Titanium requires 135,000 status points in the 2026 program. Atmos Platinum requires 80,000.
questions.scope: Alaska and Hawaiian’s Atmos Rewards status thresholds for 2026
questions.caveat: Specific to Atmos Rewards. Platinum and Titanium both map to oneworld Emerald.

questions.question: Which is the higher Flying Blue status?
questions.explanation: Ultimate is the top Flying Blue status, one tier above Platinum. It has its own qualifying points requirement.
questions.scope: Air France and KLM’s published Flying Blue loyalty tiers
questions.caveat: Ranking within Flying Blue only. Ultimate has separate qualification criteria tied to eligible flights.

questions.question: Which Whisper speech model has more parameters?
questions.explanation: Turbo has 809 million parameters. Medium has 769 million. A name about speed landed between two names about size.
questions.scope: Multilingual Whisper checkpoints in the OpenAI model table
questions.caveat: Parameter counts compare size alone. Speed also depends on the hardware and recording.

questions.question: Which syslog message is more urgent?
questions.explanation: Alert means someone must act immediately. It is level 1. Critical is level 2, one step less urgent.
questions.scope: Syslog severity names defined in RFC 5424
questions.caveat: Higher urgency has a smaller numeric code.

questions.question: Which built-in GitHub role can label someone else’s issue?
questions.explanation: Triage lets a contributor label and close other people’s issues. Read lets them participate in the discussion.
questions.scope: Built-in roles for repositories owned by GitHub organizations
questions.caveat: Custom roles and branch protection can change what an individual can do.

questions.question: Which USDA label goes on the bigger whole olives?
questions.explanation: Colossal olives run 41–50 to a pound. Jumbo takes 51–60. The USDA even has a Super Colossal.
questions.scope: USDA Table I for canned whole ripe olives
questions.metric: size of an individual whole olive
questions.caveat: The count-per-pound ranges apply to whole ripe olives.

questions.question: Start with the same sheet of paper. Which book format gives you larger pages?
questions.explanation: One sheet makes four leaves in quarto or eight in octavo. Each quarto leaf has twice the area.
questions.scope: Traditional book formats folded from identical sheets of paper
questions.metric: area per leaf from an equal sheet
questions.caveat: The original sheet size matters when comparing actual books.

questions.question: At the same type size, which space is conventionally wider?
questions.explanation: An em space spans one em. An en space is half that width. At 12-point type the nominal widths are 12 and 6 points.
questions.scope: Conventional space widths in Unicode General Punctuation
questions.metric: nominal width at the same type size
questions.caveat: Actual glyph widths can vary by font and justification.

questions.question: Which U.S. album award takes more certified units?
questions.explanation: Diamond starts at ten million album units in the U.S. Nine-times Platinum requires nine million.
questions.scope: U.S. RIAA Album Awards under the standard album program
questions.caveat: Units include eligible streaming and downloads as well as album sales.

questions.question: Which unit contains the other on the geologic time scale?
questions.explanation: A period contains epochs. The Quaternary is a period. The Pleistocene and Holocene are its epochs.
questions.scope: Formal units on the USGS geologic time chart
questions.metric: rank of a geologic time unit
questions.caveat: This compares ranks in the hierarchy. Individual units have different durations.

questions.question: Which was the larger Jurassic-2 model before AI21 renamed them?
questions.explanation: Grande sat above Large, and Jumbo sat above both. AI21 later renamed the three tiers Light, Mid, and Ultra.
questions.scope: The original Jurassic-2 names, before the 2023 renaming
questions.caveat: These comparisons use the original names within the Jurassic-2 family.

questions.question: Which Jurassic-2 model did AI21 rename Ultra?
questions.explanation: Jumbo was the largest Jurassic-2 model. When AI21 changed the names, Grande became Mid and Jumbo became Ultra.
questions.scope: The original Jurassic-2 names, before the 2023 renaming
questions.caveat: These comparisons use the original names within the Jurassic-2 family.

questions.question: Which was the larger model in Google’s PaLM 2 lineup?
questions.explanation: Google ordered PaLM 2 as Gecko, Otter, Bison, and Unicorn—increasing by animal size until the largest tier switched to a mythical creature.
questions.scope: The four PaLM 2 sizes Google announced in 2023
questions.caveat: Google published the size order without giving parameter counts in its launch announcement.

questions.question: Which DeepMind model had more parameters?
questions.explanation: Gopher had 280 billion parameters to Chinchilla’s 70 billion. DeepMind trained Chinchilla on four times as much data, and it beat Gopher on most tests.
questions.scope: The two language models compared in DeepMind’s 2022 Chinchilla study
questions.caveat: These were research models. Parameter count and benchmark results give different answers.

questions.question: Which original GPT-3 base model cost more per token?
questions.explanation: Davinci cost $20 per million tokens and Curie cost $2. Ada, Babbage, Curie, Davinci. The prices went up in alphabetical order.
questions.scope: Base GPT-3 completion models at their published prices before retirement
questions.caveat: These are historical rates for the base models, distinct from the text-prefixed models.
